coverage_approach: Broad queries include long-tail results (relevance=1) to maximize recall. Strict scoring at top ranks (relevance=3), generous in tail.
notes: Initial golden dataset with 3 queries focused on NGO/nonprofit technology solutions. Query 1 and 2 have 22-24 results each (broad), Query 3 has 16 results (medium-specific). Relevance based on user intent and sector alignment.
